scope: Conservative display review of newly collected HanDian entry-associated specimens; original 171 manually reviewed character etymologies are unchanged.
method: Decode only a unified/compatibility Han codepoint in a Shuowen SVG filename. If it differs from both the target character and source entry first traditional value, collapse that exact source specimen to a labelled provenance link. The filename index is not an archaeological character identity determination.
interpretation: Flagged entries are unconfirmed associations, not a list of proven source errors. They can include historical variants, ancient/modern character relationships, phonetic carriers, different senses, simplified-character mergers and possible source-link errors. Unflagged entries are not thereby independently confirmed direct evolution.
displayPolicy: For all new records use an entry-associated-reference heading, no ancient-to-target evolution arrows and no ancient-image identity quizzes. For flagged exact target+stage+URL records show provenance/index labels in a collapsed related-examples section; do not display their images by default.
